shortDescription: Manages templates on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: account
options.description: Account the template, snapshot or VM is related to.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: bits
options.description: 32 or 64 bits support.

options.name: checksum
options.description: The MD5 checksum value of this template. If set, we search by checksum instead of name.

options.name: cross_zones
options.description: Whether the template should be synced or removed across zones. Only used if I(state) is C(present) or C(absent).

options.name: details
options.description: Template details in key/value pairs.

options.name: display_text
options.description: Display text of the template.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain the template, snapshot or VM is related to.

options.name: format
options.description: The format for the template. Only considered if I(state=present).

options.name: hypervisor
options.description: Name the hypervisor to be used for creating the new template. Relevant when using I(state=present). Possible values are C(KVM), C(VMware), C(BareMetal), C(XenServer), C(LXC), C(HyperV), C(UCS), C(OVM), C(Simulator).

options.name: is_dynamically_scalable
options.description: Register the template having XS/VMware tools installed in order to support dynamic scaling of VM CPU/memory. Only used if I(state) is C(present).

options.name: is_extractable
options.description: Allows the template or its derivatives to be extractable.

options.name: is_featured
options.description: Register the template to be featured. Only used if I(state) is C(present).

options.name: is_public
options.description: Register the template to be publicly available to all users. Only used if I(state) is C(present).

options.name: is_routing
options.description: Sets the template type to routing, i.e. if template is used to deploy routers. Only considered if I(url) is used.

options.name: mode
options.description: Mode for the template extraction. Only used if I(state=extracted).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the template.

options.name: os_type
options.description: OS type that best represents the OS of this template.

options.name: password_enabled
options.description: Enable template password reset support.

options.name: poll_async
options.description: Poll async jobs until job has finished.

options.name: project
options.description: Name of the project the template to be registered in.

options.name: requires_hvm
options.description: Whether the template requires HVM or not. Only considered while creating the template.

options.name: snapshot
options.description: Name of the snapshot, created from the VM ROOT volume, the template will be created from. I(vm) is required together with this argument.

options.name: sshkey_enabled
options.description: True if the template supports the sshkey upload feature. Only considered if I(url) is used (API limitation).

options.name: state
options.description: State of the template.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags. Tags are a list of dictionaries having keys I(key) and I(value). To delete all tags, set a empty list e.g. I(tags: []).

options.name: template_filter
options.description: Name of the filter used to search for the template. The filter C(all) was added in 2.7.

options.name: template_find_options
options.description: Options to find a template uniquely. More than one allowed.

options.name: template_tag
options.description: The tag for this template.

options.name: url
options.description: URL of where the template is hosted on I(state=present). URL to which the template would be extracted on I(state=extracted). Mutually exclusive with I(vm).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vm
options.description: VM name the template will be created from its volume or alternatively from a snapshot. VM must be in stopped state if created from its volume. Mutually exclusive with I(url).

options.name: zone
options.description: Name of the zone you wish the template to be registered or deleted from. Required when I(cross_zones) is C(false)
